# Yield Bookkeeping Services, LLC

> Woman-owned, award-winning bookkeeping firm serving small businesses and nonprofits nationwide. Full-charge bookkeeping, QuickBooks management, payroll, and financial reporting. 100% US-based accountants — no offshore outsourcing.

Yield Bookkeeping Services was founded in 2013 by Rochelle Dallons and is based in Brambleton, Virginia. The firm provides remote, full-charge bookkeeping for startups, small-to-mid-sized businesses, restaurants, and nonprofits across the United States, with a dedicated account manager assigned to every client.

## Services
- [Bookkeeping Services](https://yieldbookkeeping.com/services-new/): Full-charge bookkeeping — transaction entry, accounts payable/receivable, bank & credit-card reconciliations, and monthly financial statements.
- [QuickBooks & Payroll](https://yieldbookkeeping.com/services-new/): QuickBooks setup and ongoing management, payroll processing, bill pay, and invoicing.
- [Accounting & Analysis](https://yieldbookkeeping.com/services-new/): Cash-flow management, budgeting, financial analysis, forensic accounting, and form filing.
- [Who We Serve](https://yieldbookkeeping.com/clients/): Startups, small and mid-sized businesses, restaurants, and nonprofits nationwide.

## About
- [Our Team](https://yieldbookkeeping.com/our-team-2-2/): Founded 2013 by Rochelle Dallons. Woman-owned. Staffed exclusively by US-based full-time and part-time accountants.
